question: Where does the headquarters of the Indian Council of Agricultural Research Institute located?
solution:
The correct answer is New Delhi.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Indian Council of Agricultural Research (ICAR) **has its **headquarters in New Delhi.**
 
• The **Department of Agricultural Research and Education (DARE)**, **Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare, Government of India**, is where the independent **Indian Council of Agricultural Research (ICAR) **is housed.
 
• The** Imperial Council of Agricultural Research**, formerly known as** ICAR**, was created on** July 16, 1929** as an organisation under the **Societies Registration Act, 1860**, in response to the **Royal Commission on Agriculture's** findings.
 
• **Narendra Singh Tomar** is the cabinet secretary of the **Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers' Welfare**.
